guides.title: Polarized sunglasses
guides.intro: These are the colorways whose merchant page titles the lens as polarized, plus every Costa frame, because Costa says it sells only polarized sunglasses. A model can also offer a non-polarized colorway at a different price. Where we did not read a price, the button says check today's price.

Oakley Half Jacket 2.0 XL is here because the colorway we priced is named Prizm Deep Water Polarized. guides.title: Ray-Ban vs Oakley
guides.intro: Ray-Ban and Oakley are different companies and different shapes. This page puts the Wayfarer RB2140 colorway next to the Holbrook colorways we priced, because those are the two models people use as the stand-in for each brand. It is not a score.
points: Wayfarer RB2140, polished black, G-15, 50-22: the Ray-Ban page we opened did not show a price.
Holbrook OO9102, matte black, Prizm Grey: Oakley showed $174.00. The Prizm Black Polarized colorway of the same model showed $237.00.
Wayfarer on this page is a G-15 lens. Holbrook's priced everyday colorway is Prizm Grey, and polarized is a separate Holbrook colorway.
Both links go to the brand's own US site. CJ applications for Ray-Ban (3175074) and Oakley (1463156) are still pending, so the buttons are plain URLs.

guides.title: Wayfarer vs New Wayfarer
guides.intro: These are two Ray-Ban model codes, not two sizes of one frame. The colorways linked here are the ones whose pages we opened.
points: Wayfarer is RB2140. The linked colorway is polished black, G-15 green, titled 50-22.
New Wayfarer is RB2132. The linked colorway is polished tortoise, G-15 green, titled 55-18.
A New Wayfarer Flash page is titled 52-18, so RB2132 is sold in more than one lens width. Do not treat 55 mm as the only New Wayfarer size.
Neither product page showed a price in the text we could read on November 15, 2026.

guides.title: Holbrook vs Frogskins
guides.intro: Both are square Oakley lifestyle frames in O Matter. The prices below are the colorways Oakley showed on November 15, 2026, not a sale we invented.
points: Holbrook OO9102, matte black, Prizm Grey, XL 140 mm, 6-base lens: $174.00. Prizm Black Polarized on the same model: $237.00.
Frogskins OO9013, polished black, Prizm Black, XL 137 mm, 4-base lens: $160.00. That colorway is not labeled polarized.
Oakley says both models offer polarized and Iridium lenses. Only the Holbrook polarized colorway had a price we read.
Holbrook's page mentions metal rivets. Frogskins' page describes the frame as the 1980s tooling brought back.
